sources.title: Elections 2010 results poll by poll
sources.source_description:
Provides poll-by-poll results as well as the number of registered voters and votes cast by poll station. Includes data for mayoral, Councillor, and school board positions.

Accuracy: There are no known errors in these data sets; however, these should not be considered official results, please refer to ottawa.ca for official results: http://ottawa.ca/en/city_hall/elections/elections2010/official_results/index.htm

Update Frequency: As needed

Contact: Elections & MFIPPA Branch

Download note: If you are having problems downloading using Microsoft Edge as your web browser, try disabling the “Open Office files in the browser” option in Settings.

gaps: 2010 City workbook is not certified and lacks council data for wards 7 and 15.
2010 ballots cast are unavailable in this workbook. Total Votes are candidate votes, not turnout.
2014 full ward ballots cast are unavailable. The legacy Ward 4 registered-voter count was 30 too low (22548 instead of 22578).
2014/2018/2022 mayor special citywide polls (code 99) cannot be allocated to residential wards from these workbooks.
Population and under-18 constants remain unverified; see the dated retrieval failure in SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md.
Historical ward results have not been reaggregated onto 2022 boundaries. Ward 24 has no pre-2022 result.
